title: Dolly Parton Cause of Death Revealed
summary: The icon died Tuesday after "a brief battle with cancer," her team shares.
body: Dolly Parton, who died today at age 80 , went through “a brief battle with cancer,” according to a statement released Tuesday evening (Aug. 25) by her team. Parton died at Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center in Nashville. “Our beloved Dolly Parton spent her life and career bringing joy, laughter, hope and integrity into everything she touched,” read the statement simply signed Team Dolly. “Her unmatched generosity reached the lives of countless people whom she would never meet, yet she was always there to offer a helping hand. Whether it be the hundreds of millions of books donated through her invaluable Imagination Library or funding research that helped create a lifesaving vaccine used around the world, Dolly’s unconditional love for all people was the guiding force for her lasting impact. After bravely facing a brief battle with cancer, Dolly departed her Earthly life today at the Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center surrounded by loved ones.” Related A Timeline of Dolly Parton’s Good Deeds Fearless, Fabulous Dolly Parton and What We Can All Learn From Her: A Remembrance Dolly Parton, One of Country Music’s Biggest & Brightest Icons, Dies at 80…

title: Youth Music Awards Heads to Liverpool for 2026 Ceremony: See Full List of Nominations
summary: The judging panel features artists Myles Smith, Bicep & ALT BLK ERA.
body: The Youth Music Awards are hitting the road. Nominations for the 2026 ceremony have been unveiled, with this year’s event moving from London to Liverpool for the first time since its launch in 2019. Taking place at St George’s Hall on Oct. 28, the event shines a spotlight on the emerging artists and community projects helping shape the future of British music. The 2026 shortlist spans 11 categories, recognising talent both onstage and behind the scenes, as well as the young leaders working to make the U.K. music industry more accessible. More than 60 judges from across the sector will select this year’s winners, representing companies including Apple, Meta, Sony Music, Spotify, Universal Music Group and YouTube. Artist judges include BRIT Award winner Myles Smith, DJ duo Bicep, heavy rockers ALT BLK ERA, Faithless’ Sister Bliss and BBC Radio 1Xtra and BBC Introducing presenters Snoochie Shy and Jess Izsatt. Among this year’s nominees are several Liverpudlian acts, spanning singer-songwriters Livvy K, Bethane and Astles to rapper KOJ, giving the host city a strong presence across the shortlist. title: Fearless, Fabulous Dolly Parton and What We Can All Learn From Her: A Remembrance
summary: Parton died Aug. 25 at the age of 80, leaving far more than just her incredible career in music behind.
body: When the news broke today that Dolly Parton had died, everyone in the Billboard newsroom from the most seasoned veteran to the college intern shed a tear — because it felt like, as one person said, “an angel had just died.” The world already feels like a colder place without her in it. Everyone loved Dolly Parton because Dolly Parton honestly loved everyone. (Which is very different from liking everyone.) Parton felt like the one person on earth that everyone could agree was nothing but a universal good. Groups who were famously at odds, such as conservative Christians and the LGBTQIA community, agreed on their love for Dolly. Today she’s even being mourned by The Muppets . Parton generally declined to talk politics or politically charged issues, but she very clearly made her strong opinions known, and the thread always led back to treating people with love, compassion and kindness. Parton, a public and devout Christian, constantly stressed that she wasn’t here to judge; she’d leave that up to God. But that doesn’t mean she played it safe. Not in her words or in her music. title: Lil Nas X Says Fans Are Being ‘OD Nice’ to Him Since He Got Out of Rehab
summary: The "Old Town Road" rapper/singer seems to be in positive spirits since finding himself in legal trouble last summer.
body: Lil Nas X is trying to keep a positive attitude since getting out of rehab. The rapper and singer posted an Instagram Reel telling fans that everyone has been treating him very well since he came from a recent rehab stint. “Ever since I got out of rehab, like, everybody’s, like, OD nice to me,” he said jokingly. “I can be like, ‘Hey!’ Everybody’s gonna be like, ‘Oh my God, you’re so brave.’ I can try to post a thirst trap on my Instagram Story, and then it’s gonna be somebody like, ‘Keep fighting, King.'” In keeping with his newfound positivity, he posted an Instagram Story holding a cake to celebrate his 10,000th day on planet Earth and poked fun at the people that may not make it to day 10,000. “So, tomorrow is my 10,000th day alive and I made it,” he said. “A lot of you won’t make it, but I made it.” Back in June, Nas posted an IG Reel to give his fans and followers an update of where he’s been. “I’ve been in rehab for a few months,” he said. “Since then I’ve been back home, whether its in Atlanta with my family or in Los Angeles with myself, frien…

The animation has been tinted to simulate what a human would see if they were watching the transit from the Martian surface through protective solar eclipse glasses. Perseverance has captured several Phobos transits since its landing at Jezero Crater in February 2021. By comparing the various recordings, scientists can refine their understanding of the potato-shaped moon’’ orbit, learning how it is changing.
